before14.styles: Instrumental hard rock, fixed 175 BPM in G Minor, straight 4/4 from the first bar through the final hit. Strong punchy kick and cracking snare carry an unmistakable full-speed running step throughout. Guitar and bass strike a unison G-pedal riff, then break it into G5 -> Bb5 -> C5 -> D5 with a Dorian-colored C5. A huge live kick and cracking snare anchor the stride while a second guitar answers the unison figure in higher octaves. The main hook opens the chord hits and doubles the riff. Aim for about 3:24.
before14.exclude: vocals, spoken word, jazz, drill, half-time drums, tempo changes, beatless breakdown, ambient intro
before14.title: 14. 높은 기어
